product.name: Monoprice Heavy Duty Power Cord - Locking NEMA L6-20P to IEC 60320 C13 14AWG 15A/1800W SJT 250V Black 6ft
product.description: Connect network servers and other peripherals with a PDU, UPS, or other AC power source with a NEMA® L6‑20R locking outlet. Locking plugs have the pins arrayed in a circular manner and is inserted and twisted to lock in place.This cable features a female IEC 60320 C13 connector on one end and a male NEMA L6‑20P connector on the other end. Simply mate the female C13 connector with the male C14 connector on your device or power adapter, then plug the NEMA connector into a nearby UPS or other AC power source.
